scope: Independent before-results source-inventory and exact-incumbent audit; no fitting, portfolio replay, candidate scoring, or market performance examination

checks.criterion: Start exact SOXX F=0; first strictly higher F among feasible epochs0..120; compare selected_epoch, F, full saved payload with models/development.pkl

verified_artifacts.scope: schema inspection only; no strategy metrics calculated

verified_artifacts.hashes: Every file verified against the pinned parent manifest before and after Recorder.load_object

boundary_notes: Budget cap means first strict best feasible training incumbent up to cap, not checkpoint exactly at cap. Budget zero is exact benchmark, not interior epoch zero.
Validation candidate books use their own budget-specific prior-year models; only final adaptive and fixed120 evaluation streams share forced120 warmup2016/2017.
For yearY, only preceding two signal years with return_available_at strictly before Jan1Y are scoreable. Late-December signal dates alone do not establish maturity.
Do not concatenate independently restarted annual portfolio returns: carry one owned book across the two validation years and across final evaluation years.
All three fixed seeds are combined on one owned book; rerun original training ensemble feasibility acceptance per cap, do not average seed PnLs or select seed subsets.
Exact120 model identity alone is insufficient; final runner must also reproduce archived daily holdings/returns/fees/turnover at both costs before attributing selector changes.
Explicit null is a fifth model candidate. Its selection is no-edge evidence, not proof learned alpha or training regularization improved.
All evaluated history is reused; this temporal selection package cannot erase historical research-selection bias or establish new forward qualification.
limitations: This review verified every original cap120 seed incumbent but did not independently replay its portfolio or evaluate shorter-budget policy performance.
Numerical training feasibility and immutable source provenance do not establish out-of-sample investment qualification.
